Reduce salt and weigh yourself daily. See a doctor promptly if your weight rises by more than 2 kg in three days or your breathlessness worsens, and call an ambulance for severe shortness of breath at rest.
قصور القلب مع كسر قذفي محفوظ (تيبّس عضلة: Heart failure with preserved ejection fraction (stiff heart muscle)

Treatment includes diuretics to relieve fluid build-up and heart-protective medicines, along with controlling blood pressure, blood sugar and weight, treating atrial fibrillation if present, and a gradual physical activity programme. See a doctor if swelling or breathlessness increases, and call an ambulance for severe shortness of breath at rest.

يُشخَّص بتخطيط القلب وجهاز هولتر لمراقبة: Diagnosed with an ECG and a Holter monitor. Medicines that slow the heart are reviewed, and the main treatment for symptoms is a permanent pacemaker, with anticoagulants if atrial fibrillation is also present. See a doctor promptly, and go to the emergency department if fainting recurs.

يُشخَّص بتخطيط القلب، ويُقيَّم بدراسة كه: Diagnosed with an ECG and assessed with an electrophysiology study. Catheter ablation is a successful definitive treatment in most cases, and some medicines that slow conduction through the AV node are avoided if atrial fibrillation is present. See a cardiologist, and go to the emergency department if palpitations come with fainting or chest pain.

It may be inherited or caused by medicines or low salts (electrolytes), and it raises the risk of a dangerous ventricular arrhythmia causing fainting or sudden death.

Treatment includes stopping medicines that prolong the QT interval, correcting electrolytes, beta blockers and sometimes an implantable defibrillator. See a doctor promptly, and go to the emergency department if you faint.

Treatment includes bringing down a fever quickly, avoiding certain medicines, and an implantable defibrillator for those who have fainted or had a cardiac arrest. See a doctor, and go to the emergency department if a finger or toe turns black or the pain suddenly gets worse.

Your doctor may prescribe calcium channel blockers for frequent attacks. See a doctor to rule out an autoimmune cause if it starts after age 30 or comes with finger ulcers, joint pain or skin thickening.
التهاب وتجلّط في وريد سطحي تحت الجلد، غا: Inflammation and clotting in a vein just under the skin, often in leg varicose veins or at the site of an IV line. It appears as a hard, painful, red cord and can sometimes extend into the deep veins.

Treatment includes warm compresses, raising the leg and anti-inflammatory medicines, with an anticoagulant if it is long or close to the deep veins. See a doctor, and seek help immediately if the whole leg swells or you develop shortness of breath or chest pain.

It is preceded by nausea, sweating and blurred vision, and the person recovers quickly without confusion.

Prevent it by drinking enough fluids and avoiding triggers, and by lying down with your legs raised or tensing your arm and leg muscles when you feel warning signs. Go to the emergency department if fainting happens during exertion, with chest pain or palpitations, without warning, or in someone with heart disease.
اضطراب في الجهاز العصبي اللاإرادي يرتفع: A disorder of the autonomic nervous system in which the heart rate rises by 30 beats or more within 10 minutes of standing without a significant drop in blood pressure, with dizziness, palpitations and fatigue. يُشخَّص بقياس النبض والضغط مستلقيًا ثم و: Diagnosed by measuring heart rate and blood pressure lying down and then standing, with tests to rule out other causes. See a doctor.
ارتفاع ضغط ناتج عن سبب محدد قابل للعلاج،: High blood pressure due to a specific treatable cause, such as kidney disease, renal artery narrowing, hyperaldosteronism, phaeochromocytoma, sleep apnoea or some medicines. It is suspected in young people or when blood pressure resists treatment.

See a doctor, and go to the emergency department if your blood pressure is above 180/120 with symptoms.

See a doctor for a risk assessment and regular follow-up.

التهاب رئوي شديد تسببه بكتيريا الليجيوني: A severe pneumonia caused by Legionella bacteria, spread by breathing in spray from contaminated water in central air conditioning, cooling towers or water systems in hotels and hospitals. It may come with diarrhoea and confusion.
يحتاج تقييمًا في اليوم نفسه بأشعة صدر وا: Needs same-day assessment with a chest X-ray and a urine antigen test. It is treated with suitable antibiotics, and hospital admission is often needed. It does not spread from person to person, and it is reported to the health authorities to trace the source.

يُشخَّص بأشعة الصدر والمقطعية ومزرعة الب: Diagnosed with a chest X-ray, CT scan and sputum culture. It is treated with antibiotics for weeks, and rarely with drainage or surgery, along with dental treatment and treating the cause. See a doctor the same day, and go to the emergency department if you cough up blood or are short of breath.
تجمّع صديد في الغشاء المحيط بالرئة، غالب: A collection of pus in the lining around the lung, usually as a complication of pneumonia. It is suspected when fever persists or returns with pain on one side of the chest despite antibiotics.
يحتاج دخول المستشفى: أشعة صدر وموجات صوت: Needs hospital admission: a chest X-ray, chest ultrasound and a sample of the fluid, then a chest drain to remove the pus with antibiotics for weeks, and sometimes medicines to break down adhesions or keyhole surgery.
تجمّع سائل بين الرئة وجدار الصدر، له أسب: A build-up of fluid between the lung and the chest wall. It has many causes, the most common being heart failure, pneumonia, cancer, tuberculosis, and liver and kidney disease, and it causes increasing shortness of breath.
يُشخَّص بأشعة الصدر والموجات الصوتية، وغ: Diagnosed with a chest X-ray and ultrasound, and often a sample of the fluid is taken for analysis to find the cause. The cause is treated, the fluid is drained if you are short of breath, and procedures may be needed to stop it coming back. See a doctor within a day, and go to the emergency department for shortness of breath at rest.
التهاب في الغشاء المحيط بالرئة بعد عدوى: Inflammation of the lining around the lung, usually after a viral infection. It causes a sharp, stabbing pain on one side of the chest that gets worse with deep breathing and coughing, without severe shortness of breath.
يحتاج فحصًا طبيًا لاستبعاد الأسباب الخطي: Needs a medical examination to rule out serious causes of pleuritic chest pain such as a pulmonary embolism, pneumonia or a collapsed lung. It is usually treated with anti-inflammatory medicines and rest and improves within days to two weeks. Call an ambulance for sudden shortness of breath or coughing up blood.
ارتفاع الضغط في شرايين الرئة يجهد الجانب: High blood pressure in the lung arteries that strains the right side of the heart. Causes include left heart disease, chronic lung disease and chronic lung clots, or it may be primary. It causes shortness of breath on exertion that gradually gets worse.
يبدأ بالموجات الصوتية على القلب، ويُؤكَّ: It starts with an echocardiogram and is confirmed by right heart catheterisation at a specialist centre, with a search for the cause. See a doctor, and go to the emergency department if you faint or have chest pain.
نوع مزمن متقدم من التليّف الرئوي دون سبب: A chronic, progressive type of lung scarring with no known cause, usually affecting people over 60. It causes a dry cough and shortness of breath that worsen over months, with finger clubbing and crackles in the chest.

See a respiratory specialist.
مرض التهابي غير معروف السبب تتكوّن فيه ع: An inflammatory disease of unknown cause in which small inflammatory lumps (granulomas) form, usually in the lungs and chest lymph nodes. It may also affect the skin, eyes and heart, and causes a dry cough and shortness of breath.
يُشخَّص بأشعة الصدر والمقطعية وأخذ عينة: Diagnosed with a chest X-ray and CT scan, and usually a tissue sample (biopsy), with eye and heart checks. التهاب الرئة التحسسي (رئة مربي الطيور أو: Hypersensitivity pneumonitis (bird fancier's or farmer's lung)
التهاب في الرئة ناتج عن تحسس مناعي لمواد: Lung inflammation caused by an immune reaction to inhaled organic material such as bird feathers and droppings, mould or mouldy hay. It causes cough, shortness of breath and mild fever after exposure, and may lead to scarring if exposure continues.
يُشخَّص بالتاريخ المهني والمنزلي والأشعة: Diagnosed from work and home history, CT scan and lung function tests. The most important treatment is identifying the source and avoiding it completely, with steroids or other medicines for severe or long-term cases. See a respiratory specialist.
تليّف رئوي مزمن ينتج عن استنشاق غبار معد: Chronic lung scarring caused by breathing in mineral dust at work for years, such as silica dust in quarries and sandblasting, asbestos fibres or coal dust. It appears years later as shortness of breath and cough.
يُشخَّص بالتاريخ المهني وأشعة الصدر والم: Diagnosed from work history, chest X-ray, CT scan and lung function tests. No treatment reverses the scarring; the key steps are stopping exposure, stopping smoking, vaccinations, pulmonary rehabilitation and oxygen if needed, with tuberculosis screening in people with silicosis and monitoring for cancer risk. See a respiratory or occupational health specialist.

يُشخَّص بالتاريخ المهني وقياس وظائف الرئ: Diagnosed from work history and lung function tests before and after a work shift. تفاقم شديد للربو يضيق فيه التنفس لدرجة ت: A severe asthma flare-up in which breathing is so difficult you cannot finish a sentence, your lips turn blue, or the reliever inhaler does not help. It can be life-threatening.

تضيّق مؤقت في الشعب الهوائية يحدث أثناء: Temporary narrowing of the airways during exercise or within minutes after it, especially in cold, dry air, causing wheeze, cough or chest tightness. It may be part of asthma or occur on its own in athletes.
يُؤكَّد بقياس وظائف الرئة أو اختبار تحدٍ: Confirmed with lung function tests or an exercise challenge test. It is treated with a bronchodilator inhaler or a combination inhaler before exercise as prescribed by your doctor, along with a gradual warm-up, covering your nose and mouth in cold weather, and treating any underlying asthma. See a doctor, and go to the emergency department if an attack does not improve with the inhaler.
تدهور حاد في أعراض مريض الانسداد الرئوي: A sudden worsening of symptoms in someone with COPD, with more shortness of breath, cough and phlegm or a change in phlegm colour, usually due to a viral or bacterial infection or air pollution.
يُراجَع الطبيب في اليوم نفسه: زيادة المو: See a doctor the same day: use more short-acting bronchodilators, a few days of oral steroids, and an antibiotic if the phlegm changes colour, according to your treatment plan. سعال مع بلغم معظم الأيام لمدة ثلاثة أشهر: Cough with phlegm on most days for at least three months in two consecutive years, most commonly caused by smoking or exposure to smoke and dust. It is a form or early stage of COPD.
يحتاج قياس وظائف التنفس لتقييم وجود انسد: Needs breathing tests (spirometry) to check for airway obstruction. توسّع دائم في الشعب الهوائية يعيق تنظيفه: Permanent widening of the airways that makes it hard to clear mucus, causing a daily cough with large amounts of phlegm and repeated chest infections. Causes include previous infections such as tuberculosis and whooping cough, and immune deficiency.
يُشخَّص بالأشعة المقطعية عالية الدقة مع: Diagnosed with high-resolution CT, with tests to find the cause and a sputum culture. The basis of treatment is daily airway clearance exercises and techniques (chest physiotherapy), antibiotics for flare-ups, sometimes long-term preventive treatment, and vaccinations. See a respiratory specialist, and seek help immediately if you cough up a lot of blood.
تنفس سريع أو عميق أكثر من حاجة الجسم، غا: Breathing faster or deeper than the body needs, often with anxiety or panic attacks. It lowers carbon dioxide in the blood, causing tingling around the mouth and fingers, dizziness and a feeling of suffocation.
التنفس ببطء من البطن (شهيق من الأنف وزفي: Breathe slowly from your belly (in through your nose and a long breath out through your mouth) until the symptoms settle; do not breathe into a bag. التوقف عن الصعود والراحة وشرب سوائل كافي: Stop climbing, rest, drink enough fluids and take a painkiller for the headache until the symptoms go, and descend if they do not improve or get worse. Prevent it by ascending gradually; your doctor may prescribe a preventive medicine before travel. Descend immediately and get help if you become unsteady or confused or are short of breath at rest.

It causes headache, dizziness and nausea, may affect several people in the same place, and can lead to loss of consciousness and death.
اخرج الجميع فورًا إلى الهواء الطلق وأوقف: Get everyone into fresh air immediately, turn off the gas source if it is safe to do so, and call an ambulance. It is treated with high-flow oxygen, and sometimes hyperbaric oxygen in severe cases or in pregnant women. Prevent it by servicing appliances, ventilating rooms and fitting a carbon monoxide alarm.
سعال يستمر أكثر من 8 أسابيع لدى البالغ،: A cough lasting more than 8 weeks in an adult. The most common causes are asthma, acid reflux, postnasal drip, smoking and some blood pressure medicines (ACE inhibitors).
يحتاج تقييمًا طبيًا بأشعة صدر وقياس وظائ: Needs medical assessment with a chest X-ray and breathing tests, a review of medicines and smoking, then treatment of the likely cause (such as asthma, reflux or allergy). See a doctor, and seek help immediately if you cough up blood, lose weight or have worsening shortness of breath.

It is treated with positive airway pressure machines during sleep, weight loss (bariatric surgery may be discussed) and treating complications. See a respiratory or sleep specialist, and go to the emergency department for severe drowsiness or confusion.

If the episode settles but the cough or wheeze continues, same-day assessment with an X-ray is needed, usually followed by a bronchoscopy to remove the object. Do not try to remove it with your finger unless you can see it.

Go to the emergency department if it is your first headache of this kind and it is sudden and severe, or if it comes with weakness or vision problems.
صداع مزمن يحدث 15 يومًا أو أكثر في الشهر: A chronic headache on 15 or more days a month in someone with an existing headache disorder (such as migraine or tension headache), caused by regular overuse of painkillers or triptans for more than three months.
العلاج الأساسي هو إيقاف المسكن المُفرَط: The main treatment is stopping the overused painkiller under medical supervision, expecting the headache to get temporarily worse in the first weeks, then starting suitable preventive treatment for the original headache type and keeping a headache diary. ألم انتيابي واخز أو كالصعقة في توزيع الأ: Attacks of stabbing or electric shock-like pain along the occipital nerves at the back of the head, which may spread to the top of the head, with tenderness over the nerve. It may be linked to neck muscle tension or neck injuries.
الكمادات الدافئة وتصحيح وضعية الرقبة وتم: Warm compresses, correcting neck posture, stretching exercises and physiotherapy, plus simple painkillers for short periods; your doctor may prescribe nerve pain medicines or a local anaesthetic nerve block. See a doctor to rule out other causes, and go to the emergency department if the headache comes with fever and neck stiffness, weakness or confusion.
نوبة قصيرة من الأعراض العصبية المفاجئة (: A brief episode of sudden neurological symptoms (weakness or numbness on one side, speech problems or loss of vision in one eye) due to a temporary reduction in blood supply to the brain that goes away completely. توجّه إلى الطوارئ فورًا حتى لو زالت الأع: Go to the emergency department immediately even if the symptoms have gone; urgent assessment within 24 hours (brain and carotid artery imaging and an ECG) and starting antiplatelets and statins and controlling blood pressure and blood sugar greatly reduce the risk of stroke. Go to the emergency department for shortness of breath or repeated choking.

الدوار المفاجئ لدى من لديه عوامل خطر للج: Sudden vertigo in someone with risk factors for clots needs urgent assessment to rule out a stroke.

Go to the emergency department for new sudden weakness or a prolonged attack, as physical causes need to be ruled out first.

Go to the emergency department if the back pain comes with weakness or numbness in the legs or problems with bladder or bowel control.
كسر في الجزء العلوي من عظمة الفخذ قرب مف: A break in the upper part of the thigh bone near the hip joint, usually in older people after a minor fall due to osteoporosis. It causes pain in the hip or groin and inability to stand, and the leg may look shorter and turned outwards.
توجّه للطوارئ أو اطلب الإسعاف ولا تحاول: Go to the emergency department or call an ambulance, and do not try to get the injured person to stand. Surgery is usually needed within one to two days, with good pain relief, early movement after surgery and rehabilitation, followed by osteoporosis treatment and falls prevention.
فعل أو إهمال متكرر أو منفرد في علاقة يُف: A single or repeated act, or lack of appropriate action, within a relationship where there is an expectation of trust, that causes harm or distress to an older person. It includes physical, psychological, financial and sexual abuse and neglect; signs include unexplained bruises or injuries, fear, withdrawal, or poor hygiene or nutrition.
إذا كان المسن في خطر مباشر فاتصل بالشرطة: If the older person is in immediate danger, call the police or an ambulance. Talk to a doctor, social worker or elder protection services in your country for a safe and confidential assessment, documentation and treatment of injuries, and a protection plan, with support for overstretched carers.
تراكم كتلة براز صلبة في المستقيم أو القو: A build-up of a hard mass of stool in the rectum or colon that cannot be passed. It is more common in older people with limited mobility or taking medicines that cause constipation, and may show as liquid stool leaking around the mass, pain and bloating, confusion or urinary retention.
يحتاج إلى فحص طبي (غالبًا فحص المستقيم): Needs a medical examination (usually a rectal examination) and treatment with enemas, suppositories or osmotic laxatives, then prevention with fluids, fibre, movement and a review of medicines that cause constipation. Go to the emergency department for vomiting, severe bloating, not passing wind or severe pain.
ثاني أشيع أنواع الخرف، ينتج عن نقص تروية: The second most common type of dementia, caused by reduced blood flow to the brain due to repeated small or large strokes or small vessel disease. It usually worsens in steps, with slowed thinking and poor planning more than memory problems at first.
See a doctor for a memory assessment and brain imaging. Treatment focuses on preventing new strokes by controlling blood pressure, blood sugar and cholesterol, stopping smoking and taking antiplatelets if needed, along with rehabilitation and family support. Go to the emergency department for sudden worsening, weakness or new speech problems.
نوع من الخرف يتميز بتذبذب واضح في الانتب: A type of dementia marked by clear day-to-day fluctuations in attention and alertness, vivid visual hallucinations (seeing people or animals), Parkinson's-like symptoms and REM sleep behaviour disorder, with severe sensitivity to some antipsychotic medicines.
See a neurologist or geriatrician for diagnosis. Cholinesterase inhibitors help with thinking and hallucinations, and traditional antipsychotics must be avoided as they can cause serious deterioration. Physiotherapy, falls prevention and family support help.
أخبر أي طبيب بالتشخيص قبل وصف مهدئات أو: Tell any doctor about this diagnosis before they prescribe sedatives or antipsychotics.
تراجع في الذاكرة أو قدرات التفكير أكثر م: A decline in memory or thinking abilities greater than expected for age, noticed by the person or their family and confirmed by tests, while independence in daily activities is preserved. It may stay stable, improve, or progress to dementia in some people.
راجع الطبيب لاختبار الإدراك وفحص الأسباب: See a doctor for cognitive testing and checks for treatable causes (vitamin B12 deficiency, underactive thyroid, depression, medicines, hearing loss). Physical, mental and social activity, controlling blood pressure and blood sugar and good sleep are recommended, with regular reassessment.
صعوبة في نقل الطعام أو الشراب من الفم إل: Difficulty moving food or drink from the mouth into the oesophagus, common in older people especially after strokes or with dementia and Parkinson's disease. It shows as coughing or choking while eating and causes aspiration pneumonia and weight loss.
راجع الطبيب لتقييم البلع لدى أخصائي النط: See a doctor for a swallowing assessment by a speech and language therapist; a swallowing study may be done. Sitting upright during and after meals, taking small mouthfuls, adjusting food and drink texture as recommended, and good mouth hygiene help. Go to the emergency department for choking with difficulty breathing, or fever with a cough.
عدم القدرة على التحكم في خروج البراز أو: Being unable to control the passing of stool or wind. It is common in older people because of weak anal muscles, diarrhoea, faecal impaction, nerve conditions or dementia; it causes great embarrassment and may be hidden from the doctor.
راجع الطبيب لتحديد السبب، ومنه فحص المست: See a doctor to find the cause, including a rectal examination to rule out faecal impaction. Regulating stool consistency with fibre or medicines, pelvic floor exercises, going to the toilet regularly after meals and skin care help. See a doctor promptly if it starts suddenly with weakness or numbness in the legs.
إرهاق جسدي ونفسي واجتماعي يصيب من يرعى م: Physical, emotional and social exhaustion in someone who has been caring for an older person or someone with a long-term illness for a long time. It shows as tiredness, poor sleep, anxiety, depression and isolation, and may affect the quality of care.
اطلب المساعدة من الأسرة وخدمات الرعاية ا: Ask for help from family and respite or day care services, set aside time for rest, sleep and activities, join a carers' support group, and look after your own health and check-ups. See a doctor if you develop symptoms of depression or ongoing anxiety or feel you can no longer cope.
تجمّع دموي يتكوّن ببطء بين المخ وغشائه ا: A collection of blood that forms slowly between the brain and its outer covering. It is more common in older people, those taking blood thinners and people who drink alcohol, and may follow a fall or minor blow to the head that is forgotten. It appears days or weeks later as headache, confusion, weakness or repeated falls.
توجّه للطوارئ لإجراء أشعة مقطعية على الم: Go to the emergency department for a brain CT scan, especially if you take blood thinners. Depending on its size and symptoms it is treated with monitoring or surgical drainage, with a review of blood thinners. Do not stop blood thinners on your own.
العزلة الاجتماعية والوحدة لدى المسنين: Social isolation and loneliness in older people
قلة التواصل الاجتماعي أو الشعور المؤلم ب: Little social contact or a painful feeling of loneliness in older people. It is linked to a higher risk of depression, dementia, heart disease and early death.
التواصل المنتظم مع الأهل والجيران، والمش: Keep in regular contact with family and neighbours, take part in community, religious or volunteer activities or senior clubs, learn to use communication technology, and treat hearing and vision problems that get in the way of communication. See a doctor if it comes with symptoms of depression, loss of appetite or forgetfulness.
